name: tencent_ads-mcp
display_name: 腾讯广告 Tencent Ads MCP
description: 腾讯广告 Tencent Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume.

platform_mcp_tencent_ads_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TENCENT_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_tencent_ads_client_id.description: 应用 id (client_id) of your Tencent Marketing API application (developers.e.qq.com > 应用程序管理).

platform_mcp_tencent_ads_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TENCENT_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_tencent_ads_client_secret.description: 应用 secret (client_secret) of the same application.

platform_mcp_tencent_ads_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TENCENT_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_tencent_ads_refresh_token.description: refresh_token from the one-time OAuth consent (oauth/authorize → GET https://api.e.qq.com/oauth/token?grant_type=authorization_code). The runtime mints 1-day access tokens with grant_type=refresh_token; the refresh token itself expires after refresh_token_expires_in (30 days) and must then be re-authorized.

platform_mcp_tencent_ads_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TENCENT_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_tencent_ads_account_id.description: 推广帐号 id (account_id) the token may operate; used by `me` and by update_budget / pause_resume (adgroups/update needs account_id). For agency tokens use the sub-account id to operate.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET advertiser/get?account_id=…&fields=[…]&pagination_mode=PAGINATION_MODE_NORMAL&page=1&page_size=1 with the common access_token / timestamp (seconds) / nonce (32-char random) query parameters.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET advertiser/get without account_id: for an agency (代理商) token this lists all sub-accounts ('如未传 account_id，则默认拉取该代理商下属所有子客信息'); a direct advertiser token must pass account_id, so use `me` instead. raw.daily_budget is in 分 (fen). Returns the first 100 accounts (list_accounts takes no page argument); total in `total`.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Marketing API v3.0 has no campaign level: the 营销单元 (adgroup) carries the daily budget and on/off status, so campaigns here are adgroups (GET adgroups/get). status is configured_status (AD_STATUS_NORMAL / AD_STATUS_SUSPEND). The daily budget is in raw.daily_budget in 分 (fen, 1/100 CNY; 0 = unlimited), so `budget` is not mapped. `status` is not sent as a filter.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET daily_reports/get?account_id&level=REPORT_LEVEL_ADGROUP&date_range={start_date,end_date}&group_by=[date,adgroup_id]&fields=[…] (JSON-encoded query values, as the official SDK sends them); campaign_id filters on adgroup_id. cost_fen is spend in 分 (fen, 1/100 CNY). Up to 1000 rows (first page).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST adgroups/update {account_id, adgroup_id, daily_budget}: daily_budget is given in CNY (元) and sent in 分 (×100); allowed 5,000–400,000,000 分 (50–4,000,000 元), 0 = unlimited, and it may not go below 1.5× today's spend plus frozen funds. This changes spend. `currency` is ignored (CNY).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST adgroups/update {account_id, adgroup_id, configured_status} (pause → AD_STATUS_SUSPEND, resume → AD_STATUS_NORMAL). Resuming restarts spend.
